Read this as energy, not distance

Higher on the diagram means higher electron energy. The gap is an energy range without allowed bulk states, not an empty space between atoms. Particle counts and motion are illustrative.

Model assumptions & sources
Silicon (Si) — E_g(300K) = 1.120 eV. Si, Ge and GaAs use a Varshni fit, E_g(T) = E_g(0) − αT²/(T+β), anchored at 300 K; other materials use a local linear estimate. Lattice: Diamond Cubic. μₙ = 1400 cm²/Vs. nᵢ(300K) ≈ 1.50e+10 cm⁻³. Intrinsic: Eᶠ ≈ mid-gap. σ = nᵢ·q·(μₙ+μₚ).
